description: This file defines an abstract class `ReportAPI` that serves as a REST API endpoint for handling report-related requests within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for retrieving report metadata, such as headers and filters, and specifies behaviors for HTTP methods like GET. The class relies on external API models, validators, and report endpoint classes, focusing on report retrieval operations.

classes.name: ReportAPI
classes.description: An abstract REST API class for report operations, providing methods to retrieve report metadata such as headers and filters, and enforcing implementation of report retrieval on subclasses.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve report metadata including headers and filters, validating report accessibility, assembling response data and metadata.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide the specific report instance being accessed.

methods.name: getReportName
methods.description: Retrieves the report name from the request query parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request, primarily ensuring the report name parameter is valid.

methods.name: getReportNameParamRule
methods.description: Defines the validation rule for the report name parameter, requiring a string type.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method to handle UPDATE requests, not implemented and will throw an exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for UPDATE requests, not implemented.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method to handle DELETE requests, not implemented and will throw an exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for DELETE requests, not implemented.
